lines.text: No handler could see this far in. That is the first thing about it I like.
The rafters here are honest. You can see the whole room and nobody sees you. I stayed for that.
Somebody used the Beacon as a line. I cut it. If it rings again, tell me first.
Cameras. There are always cameras. Smile, or don't; they log both.
Clean. Nobody saw. Nobody ever sees.
Home. I keep saying it to see if it sticks.
